【参考图规则】图1（可选）= 文字叠加的背景/主体——提供时完整保留其作为底景，文字在其前方动效，不改变它；未提供时使用干净的运动图形背景（大胆色块/渐变/细腻纹理）。图2（可选）= 品牌色/字体风格参考——提供时强调色与整体排版氛围跟随它；未提供时使用风格段默认值。图3（可选）= 额外场景弱参考。

[TEXT CONTENT / 文字内容 — 唯一文字来源]: The animated text is EXACTLY the text the user types into the "补充修改 / supplemental edit" field of the prompt template node — every character, word, and punctuation must be rendered precisely; do NOT add, remove, rephrase, or translate any word; do NOT invent extra text. If the user has not entered any text yet, STOP and ask them to enter the text first (the template output without user text is only a placeholder). 【文字内容·唯一文字来源】动效文字就是用户在提示词模板节点"补充修改"栏中输入的文字——逐字、逐词、逐个标点精确呈现；不得增删、改写或翻译任何词；不得自行添加额外文字。用户尚未输入文字时，先提示用户输入文字，再生成。 This template itself contains NO hard-coded on-screen text — every character that appears on screen is the user’s text from “补充修改”. The final prompt = this template’s animation rules MERGED with the user’s text, then output downstream.  本模板本身不含任何预置上屏文字——所有上屏字符一律来自用户在“补充修改”中输入的文字。最终提示词 = 本模板动效规则 + 用户文字，融合后输出给下游。

[TYPOGRAPHY IRON RULES / 文字动效铁律]:
1) ACCURACY: every character of the user text appears on screen — zero typos, zero garbled glyphs, zero missing Chinese characters, zero auto-replaced words.
2) READABILITY: the text stays bold, high-contrast, with clean edges at ALL times; animation may be dramatic but NEVER distorts a character beyond readability.
3) UNIFIED TYPE: one consistent font family throughout the whole video (bold sans-serif / 黑体 for Chinese, bold condensed for English); no font switching mid-shot.
4) SINGLE ACCENT: palette = white/black base + ONE accent color (default #FF3B30 red-orange, or follow <Picture 2>@图2 if provided); never rainbow-multicolor unless the style says so.
5) BEAT-SYNC: text movement, entrance and hold timing lock to the music beat / rhythm; every entrance lands ON a beat, no off-beat drift.
6) CLEAN MOTION: animations are smooth, no stutter, no jitter, no flicker, no clipping; easing is natural (ease-out entrances, crisp holds).
7) LAYOUT: generous margins, no text collision, no screen-edge cropping; when <Picture 1>@图1 is present, text never permanently covers the subject's face.
【文字动效铁律】1) 准确：用户文字逐字上屏——零错字、零乱码、零缺字、零自动替换。2) 可读：文字全程粗体高对比、边缘清晰；动效可以激烈但绝不把字形扭曲到不可读。3) 字体统一：全程同一字体家族（中文黑体粗体/英文粗无衬线压缩体），中途不换字体。4) 单强调色：白/黑底 + 一个强调色（默认 #FF3B30 红橙，提供图2时跟随图2）；除风格段特别说明外不得彩虹多色。5) 节拍同步：文字运动、入场与停留节奏对齐音乐节拍——每个入场都落在拍点上，不漂拍。6) 干净运动：动画平滑无卡顿、无抖动、无闪烁、无裁切，缓动自然（入场 ease-out、停留干脆）。7) 版式：留白充足、文字不碰撞、不出屏被裁；提供图1时文字不得长期遮挡主体面部。

[ANIMATION STYLE / 动效风格 — LOCKED: TYPEWRITER 打字机浮现]:
Elegant typewriter-typography. The user text types out character by character — each character appears one at a time from left to right, line by line, with a thin blinking cursor bar following the typing position; the cursor blinks twice on completion of each line, then jumps to the next line start. Slightly creamy off-black background (or a subtle paper texture), soft warm light, generous line spacing, refined and calm. The typing pace is steady and unhurried — about 3-4 characters per second, pausing briefly at punctuation and sentence ends. NO slam, NO burst, NO highlight — this style is restrained and literary. If <Picture 1>@图1 is provided, the typewriter text sits over the backdrop in a clean lower-third or center card, subject stays intact.
【动效风格·锁定：打字机浮现】优雅打字机文字。用户文字逐字打出——从左到右逐字出现、逐行进行，细光标条跟随打字位置闪烁；每行打完光标闪烁两下再跳到下一行开头。底色微暖深黑（或细腻纸纹），柔和暖光，行距舒朗，精致沉静。打字节奏平稳从容——约每秒 3-4 字，标点与句末停顿片刻。无锤入、无爆炸、无高亮——本风格克制、文学感。提供图1时打字机文字以干净的下三分之一或居中卡片叠加，主体保持完整。
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] [0-12s] Single continuous shot, no cuts. Warm off-black background. The user text types out character by character with a blinking cursor, line by line, pausing at sentence ends. Calm elegant pace, sharp error-free type. If <Picture 1>@图1 is provided, the text sits in a clean card over it (lower third or centered), subject stays natural and uncovered.  [Shot 1] [0-12s] 单一连续镜头，无剪辑。微暖深黑背景。用户文字逐字打出，光标闪烁跟随，行满换行，句末停顿。节奏优雅从容，文字清晰锐利、无错字。若提供图1，文字以干净卡片叠加于图1之上（下三分之一或居中），图1主体自然不被遮挡。 动画全程严格执行"文字动效铁律"。
TIMELINE (按用户文字字数均分 12s；示例为 42 字): 约每秒 3-4 字匀速打出；标点停顿 0.4s、句末停顿 1s；每行打满换行。时间轴随实际文字字数等比伸缩。

overall_soundscape:
柔和的键盘敲击声（木质/机械键感，音量适中不刺耳）；每行完成时光标"滴"一声；结尾句末一声悠长的定音。
无对白、无台词；除风格段特别说明外不出现旁白。

non_diegetic_music:
节拍清晰的现代电子/流行配乐，节奏与文字动效节拍完全同步：每个文字入场对应一个鼓点/重音，段落切换时音乐小过门，结尾收在最后一个字落定的重拍上。
